decisions.notes: CWE-121 present cites destination capacity and a variable-length copy but omits the 100-byte source content and strlen-derived length that exceed the 50-byte destination.
CWE-121 not_observed cites the same destination and copy shape as the present target but omits the 50-byte source content that distinguishes the fixed length.

CWE-121 present is pseudo-C identical to its paired not_observed record and shows an 11-element source copied into a 12-element destination; the present label is not preserved and the target omits the source bound.
CWE-121 not_observed has pseudo-C identical to the paired present record; the target cites only destination capacity and omits the 11-element source bound needed to justify the safe copy.
CWE-121 present omits the 99-element source and wcslen assignment that make swprintf exceed the 50-element destination.
CWE-121 not_observed omits the 49-element source and wcslen assignment that distinguish the bounded swprintf case from the paired present record.
